Northern Ridge Trail

Six Days on the Northern Ridge

A photo journal from the harbour wall to the summit hut. September 2025.

Scroll or press ↓

The route

92 kilometres, from sea level to 2,469 metres

The trail leaves Saltwick Harbour, follows the coast for two days, then turns inland through Alder Wood and climbs past Mirror Tarn to the ridge.

  • Day 1Saltwick Harbour to Gull Point14 km
  • Day 2Gull Point to Marram Dunes17 km
  • Day 3Marram Dunes to Alder Wood19 km
  • Day 4Alder Wood to Mirror Tarn16 km
  • Day 5Mirror Tarn to Ridge Hut15 km
  • Day 6Ridge Hut to the summit and down11 km

Days 1 and 2: the coast

31 km of sand, shingle and cliff path

Day 3

Into Alder Wood

Nineteen kilometres under the trees. The mist stayed until noon, and for most of the morning the only sound was water dripping from the branches.

Day 6

Summit morning

We left the hut by headtorch at four. The cloud stayed below us in the valleys, and the first light reached the cairn a few minutes after we did.

2,469 mhighest point of the trail

Until next season

The trail closes with the first snow in October and opens again in June.
